hints.title: Awesome Substring Parity Property
hints.text: A string can be rearranged into a palindrome if and only if at most one character has an odd frequency count.

hints.title: Prefix Parity Bitmask
hints.text: Represent prefix parity of digits 0 through 9 as a 10-bit integer mask. Set bit d if digit d appeared an odd number of times.

hints.title: Earliest Mask Occurrence Table
hints.text: Record the earliest index for each seen mask. For the current prefix mask, check the same mask and all 10 masks differing by exactly 1 bit.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) substrings takes quadratic time, giving TLE on N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A table of 2^10 = 1024 states checks all 11 valid parity combinations in O(10) per character.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms palindrome rearrangement into at-most-one odd parity condition using prefix bitmasks.
complexity.notes: State table initialized with -1 at index 0.
